test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who made the use of gunpowder common in North India to defeat enemies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Babur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Babur,** the inaugural ruler to adopt the title of 'Badshah,' heralded the widespread adoption of gunpowder and artillery in India following his triumphs.
 
• His conquests marked the integration of Kabul and Kandahar into the Indian empire, a feat unmatched since the era of the Kushanas.
 
• **"Gunpowder,"** a blend of saltpeter, sulfur, and charcoal, gained prominence for its explosive propellant properties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **As the progenitor of the Mughal Empire** in the Indian subcontinent, Babur traced his lineage to Timur and Genghis Khan through his paternal and maternal ancestry, respectively.
 
• Posthumously, he was bestowed with the epithet Firdaws Makani ('Dwelling in Paradise').
 
• Babur's demise in 1530, in Agra, prompted his son Humayun to ascend the throne.
 
• Initially interred in Agra, Babur's remains were later transferred to Kabul in accordance with his final wishes for reburial.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ibrahim Khan Lodi,** succeeding his father Sikandar Khan Lodi, ascended to the throne as the final Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate in 1517.
 
• During Ibrahim Lodi's reign, **Daulat Khan Lodi **served as the governor of Lahore within the Lodi dynasty's administration.
 
• **Rana Sanga** held the distinction of being the last autonomous Hindu monarch in Northern India, governing a substantial domain before the onset of the Mughal Era.
